summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the compound-semiconductor photonics tooling/materials node. The strongest direct underfollowed equipment signal is Veeco, which has disclosed $250M+ in InP laser manufacturing equipment orders tied to optical interconnect scaling. Aehr Test is a smaller test-equipment candidate with direct silicon-photonics wafer-level burn-in order evidence. Coherent is included as a reference capacity anchor because its InP and AI datacenter optics exposure help validate the upstream bottleneck. Aeluma is included as a speculative shadow candidate because its III-V/300mm silicon integration platform could be relevant if native InP capacity remains constrained, but commercial proof is still early.
